markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Runed_Doorway
markers.note: The carved arch into the cottage. Warm light, a fire going.

markers.name: INT_The_Fireplace
markers.note: Sitting here with another player starts a slow conversation prompt.

markers.name: INT_Sleeping_Cat
markers.note: Adoptable. Will judge your trailer decor.

markers.name: INT_The_Golden_Dog
markers.note: Adoptable. Brings back things it should not have found.

markers.name: INT_Rabbit_Hollow
markers.note: They come out if you stay still.

markers.name: INT_The_Adoption_Sign
markers.note: Explains the companion system. One pet per trailer, more with expansions.

markers.name: INT_Feed_Bin
markers.note: Feeding another player's pet raises both of your reputations.

markers.name: INT_The_Stream
markers.note: Leads out of the sanctuary and does not come back.

markers.name: INT_Carved_Bench
markers.note: Names carved into it. All of them are players who have been here.

markers.name: INT_The_Lantern_Path
markers.note: Light every lantern on the path and something arrives at the cottage.

markers.name: INT_Companion_Drone_Nest
markers.note: Where the shoulder drone from the portal-network art is met.
